steps.code:
# Define the list of songs from the note
songs = [
    "Endless Roads by Aria Sterling",
    "Where Shadows Come to Life by Olivia Roberts",
    "Whispers of the Heart by Lily Moon, Zoey James",
    "Torn Apart by Evelyn Rose",
    "The Ghosts of Our Past by Mia Sullivan",
    "Final Goodbye by Dylan Stone",
    "In the Light of Dying Stars by Lucas Grey, Velvet Echo",
    "Heaven's Tears by Carter Knight",
    "In the Chambers of My Mind by Jasper Skye",
    "Echoes from the Abyss by Noah Bennett",
    "Trapped in a Daydream by Nova Harmony"
]

# We'll search each and find the matching song id
song_ids = []
for song in songs:
    # Parse title and artists from the string
    # Format: "Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    parts = song.split(" by ")
    title = parts[0].strip()
    artists_str = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ""
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(",") if a.strip()]
    
    # Search with full query
    resp = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=song, access_token=spotify_token, page_limit=20)
    # Find best match: title matches and all artists are present
    found = None
    for item in resp:
        if item["title"].lower() == title.lower():
            item_artists = [a["name"].lower() for a in item["artists"]]
            if all(any(artist.lower() in ia for ia in item_artists) for artist in artists):
                found = item
                break
    if found:
        song_ids.append(found["song_id"])
        print(f"Found: {title} -> {found['song_id']}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {song}")

print("All song_ids:", song_ids)
